HERO.TEXT_APP_DESCRIPTION: If data is the new gold, your call center conversations are an unexploited gold mine. We transcribe and analyze your call recordings with AI to provide actionable insights that will boost your understanding of your customers and your call center operations.

PROCESS.TEXT_STEP_1: Integrate Tellme with your CX Software Provider
PROCESS.TEXT_STEP_2: Calls will be automatically processed to extract meaningful data
PROCESS.TEXT_STEP_3: Access the results in our dynamic dashboard

PRODUCTS.TEXT_PRODUCT_1_DESCRIPTION: Step into your customer's shoes to understand the key pain points in your customer experience and discover strategies for improvement.
PRODUCTS.TEXT_PRODUCT_2_DESCRIPTION: Evaluate how well your agents are dealing with customer issues and identify knowledge gaps that could be targeted with further training.
PRODUCTS.TEXT_PRODUCT_3_DESCRIPTION: Boost your agent's knowledge of specific customers and topics with quick access to your conversation data.

BENEFITS.TEXT_BENEFIT_1_DESCRIPTION: Make informed decisions based on real customer interactions rather than subjective opinions. This way, you can ensure that you're moving your company's customer experience in the right direction.
BENEFITS.TEXT_BENEFIT_2_DESCRIPTION: Tailor analytics to your business needs—because no two companies are the same. Tellme allows you to target the topics that matter most to you. Simply provide a description of each relevant topic of conversation,  and let our analytics do the rest.
BENEFITS.TEXT_BENEFIT_3_DESCRIPTION: Provide targeted coaching and support for each call center agent with individualized performance insights.

ABOUT_US.TEXT_GOAL: We want to revolutionize CX analytics
ABOUT_US.TEXT_GOAL_DESCRIPTION: Having worked in airlines, banks, and insurance companies, we are very aware of the important role that call centers play in shaping a company's customer perception. We want to leverage these conversations in order to help companies identify recurring reasons for calling and to then discover potential solutions for these issues.
ABOUT_US.TEXT_EXPERTISE_DESCRIPTION: Our team blends backgrounds in aerospace engineering, finance, and consultancy, fostering multiple perspectives in our approach to customer satisfaction.
ABOUT_US.TEXT_VALUES_DESCRIPTION: Rooted in Swiss values of precision, quality, and reliability, we bring a meticulous approach to the ever-evolving world of AI.

FOOTER.TEXT_FOOTER_DESCRIPTION: We bring a meticulous approach to the ever-evolving world of AI.
